composition: Three matching portrait panels in a 91:83 frame, the same outer ratio as the maze and RAG thumbnails. Every panel follows the top-central diagonal bee, the honeycomb beneath it, and the next bee below. The first two images share height 127%, top 0, and object-position 40% top: approximately source x265-626, y0-806 at the 360px desktop thumbnail width. The native relief camera follows the same source region; cylinder curvature naturally compresses its outer edges.

original_reference.method: Recovered the original composite recipe to confirm both source filenames and the upper diagonal bee used by its 3D camera. Extended the shared field vertically for the portrait panels while retaining that bee.

sources.method: 640 by 1400 native Blender Cycles render at 64 samples of the existing embossed Cylinder mesh. Camera azimuth is derived from the original upper bee's UV feature, with a level view and ortho scale 7.6. The same diagonal bee, both complete wings, honeycomb and next bee align with the artwork and heightmap; the top edge of the roller is outside the frame. Broad key and fill lights, ambient fill, a rough blue-gray material and neutral Filmic contrast soften highlights and shadows. Depth of field is disabled. Source mesh geometry preserved; no changes saved to the original file.
